snippet.title: Draughts | 1952
snippet.description:
Implementation of the board game draughts (or checkers), programmed by British teacher and physicist Christopher Strachey for the Ferranti Mark I computer. This game pitted a human operator against the computer, with the game board and the position of the pieces shown one of the Ferranti Mark I's Williams Tube displays. The draughts program was first played in July 1952.

Source: guinnessworldrecords.com
